description: This file defines several reusable React functional components: Loader, ErrorBlock, EmptyState, and Modal. These components are meant for displaying loading indicators, error messages, empty state messages, and modal dialogs within a React application.

methods.name: Loader({ label = 'Loading...' })
methods.description: Displays a loading indicator with an optional label.

methods.name: ErrorBlock({ error })
methods.description: Displays an error message if an error exists.

methods.name: EmptyState({ title = 'No data', description = 'There is nothing here yet.', action })
methods.description: Displays an empty state message with optional action.

methods.name: Modal({ title, open, onClose, children, footer })
methods.description: Displays a modal dialog with a title, content, and optional footer; visible when 'open' is true.

ctags.name: EmptyState
ctags.pattern: /^export function EmptyState({ title = 'No data', description = 'There is nothing here yet.', acti/
ctags.signature: ({ title = 'No data', description = 'There is nothing here yet.', action })

ctags.name: Modal
ctags.pattern: /^export function Modal({ title, open, onClose, children, footer }) {$/
